pr.body:
## Summary
- add offline canonical datastore schema and safe pack importer
- add deterministic active-source resolver and coldstart reports
- produce full dry-run reconciliation artifacts for the June 22 pack

## Validation
- python -m json.tool schemas/task-orchestrator/canonical-datastore.schema.json
- python -m json.tool schemas/task-orchestrator/reconciliation-decision.schema.json
- python -m pytest -q tests/task_orchestrator/test_canonical_store_schema.py
- python -m compileall -q services/task-orchestrator/app tests/task_orchestrator
- git diff --check
